title: Alien Plasma Orb
description: A large transparent spherical plasma device with a glowing pink core emits vibrant neon tendrils of pink, green, and blue light. Inside the orb, a green-skinned alien with large dark eyes and ornate head markings peers out, surrounded by floating blue bubbles and two orange planets against a cosmic pink and purple nebula background.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large transparent spherical plasma device mounted on a metallic base. Inside the glowing orb, a green-skinned alien with large black eyes and intricate head patterns looks outward. Bright neon pink, green, and blue energy tendrils radiate from a bright pink central core. Blue translucent bubbles and two small orange planets float within and around the sphere. The background is a vibrant pink and purple nebula with floating particles, in a detailed psychedelic digital painting style.
